The Intelligence Bureau has released IB SA Final Result 2026 on 14th August for the Security Assistant post. The result is available online in PDF format on the official website of the Ministry of Home Affairs at mha.gov.in. The final selection is on the basis candidates’ performance in Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3 with document verification and medical examination. The selected candidates will be considered for appointment to the post of Security Assistant/Executive in the Intelligence Bureau. In this article, we have shared the complete information about IB SA/Executive 2026 result, merit list PDF, steps to download and more.

IB SA Final Result 2026 Out

The Intelligence Bureau has announced the IB Security Assistant Result for candidates who appeared in Tier 1, Tier 2 and Interview  stages for 4987 posts. The Tier-I exam was conducted on 29th and 30th September 2025 and Tier-II exam was held on 22nd February 2026. The Tier-III Interview/Personality Test was conducted from 1st June to 30th June . The final result contains the roll numbers of candidates selected for appointment to the SA/Exe post. The result PDF is arranged SIB-wise and roll number-wise, not according to merit. The result is released in PDF format with the roll numbers of qualified candidates.

IB Security Assistant Executive Result 2026

The Intelligence Bureau conducts Tier 1 (Objective), Tier 2 (Descriptive), Tier 3 (Interview), Character & Antecedent Verification and Medical Examination. Below are the key details of IB SA Final Merit List 2026.

IB Security Assistant Final Result 2026 Download Link

The Intelligence Bureau has activated the IB Security Assistant Final Result 2026 PDF link on its official website. Candidates who appeared in all stages can now download the merit list and check their qualifying status online. The result PDF includes all the roll numbers of candidates who have been selected for appointment to the post of SA/Exe in IB. Candidates are advised to carefully check their roll numbers in the list and keep a copy of the result PDF for later.

IB SA Final Result 2026: Click To Download

How to Download IB SA Exe 2026 Result?

Candidates can download IB SA Final Result PDF from the direct link given above. You can also get it from the official Ministry of Home Affairs. The IB SA Executive result is out on 14th August 2026 in PDF format. Follow the simple steps below to download the result and check your roll number.

  1. Open official MHA website, mha.gov.in
  2. Under ‘What’s New’ section you will find ‘Final Result of SA/Exe Exam -2025.’
  3. Click and open the PDF.
  4. Ctrl+F to search your roll number.
  5. Download and save the result PDF for future.

Details Mentioned in the IB SA Final Result 2026

The IB SA Executive result 2026 PDF has important information related to the final selection. Candidates should properly check the following details in the PDF.

  • Candidate roll number
  • Selection status
  • SIB-wise result details
  • Provisional candidature, wherever applicable
  • Important instructions for selected candidates

Candidates whose roll numbers are marked with (P) in the IB SA Final Result 2026 PDF have a provisional candidature because some required documents or information were not submitted during document verification. Such candidates need to submit the required documents at the earliest or at the time of joining.

What is Next After IB SA Final Result 2026?

Candidates whose roll number is there in the IB SA final result 2026 PDF will move to the final stage joining process. Their character and background verification will be conducted, followed by required medical examination. Candidates need to also complete any pending document or eligibility checks. Those who clear all these stages and meet the required conditions will be considered for appointment to the Security Assistant/Executive post.

FAQs on IB SA Exe Final Result 2026

Q1. When was the IB SA Final Result 2026 released?

Ans. The Intelligence Bureau has released the IB SA 2026 Result on 14th August on MHA website @mha.gov.in.

Q2. How can I download the IB Security Assistant Result 2026 PDF?

Ans. You can download the IB Security Assistant Result 2026 PDF from the link given in the article above.

Q3. What details are mentioned in the IB SA Merit List PDF 2026?

Ans. The IB SA Merit List PDF shows the state wise roll numbers, category details of candidates selected.

Q5. In which mode is the IB SA Result 2026 released?

Ans. The IB SA Final Result 2026 has been released online in PDF format for all shortlisted candidates.
